note: One rule set for columns that may identify people or places, read by the server (app.datalab.engine.profile) and by the browser before a CSV is uploaded (owner decision 2026-10-04). Patterns are written so Python and JavaScript read them alike. A keyword counts when only non-letters touch it, so gps_lat, hh_phone and Latitude2 are recognised. A name column of a place or an organisation (district_name, school name) is not personal; a village name is.
